newsitem.title: KENYA: Arson attacks in Kenya port of Mombasa - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Arson attacks in Kenya port of Mombasa - witnesses.

text.p: Arsonists set ablaze up to 100 roadside kiosks and dozens of houses in the port city of Mombasa on Sunday after five Kenyans were killed and many wounded in a night attack by unidentified raiders, witnesses said.

The latest violence prompted authorities to redeploy the army to back regular police and paramilitary units battling to contain five days of clashes in Mombasa. The identity and motive of the attackers remained a mystery.
"I personally counted up to 100 kiosks completely burned down. Dozens of houses were also set on fire in the Diani area," said Reuters reporter Edmund Kwena.
Kwena said truckloads of soldiers were immediately deployed in the area south of Mombasa and senior army officers landed by helicopter to assess the latest outbreak of violence.

Army and navy units were withdrawn on Saturday and more police and paramilitary forces were sent in to tackle the crisis, which erupted on Wednesday night after six police officers were killed by unknown attackers.
